result.reason: This is one DLO-observed production deployment, not a paired control/candidate proof.

remaining_uncertainty: The fixed 0.50 rad/s centering correction and zero-yaw confirmation hold require a supervised physical run.
The prior run proved that proportional 0.24 to 0.30 rad/s corrections could time out without centering, but it did not capture per-command live telemetry or a completed-test snapshot.

The deployment adapter did not emit current context bytes, cache or rebuild step counts, image bytes, layer counts, or isolated observer overhead; historical and nearest-comparable aggregates are labeled separately.
The DLO 0.6 Go rewrite was used because the required legacy Python branch is no longer available from the source repository.
Readiness was verified through a separate device API check because this deployment event did not observe a readiness phase.
No paired control deployment was run, so this observation cannot support a performance improvement claim.
